description: The agent must follow the full clawlist workflow: (1) Produce a brainstorming artifact clarifying the intent and approaches for the log anomaly monitoring task. (2) Produce a write-plan artifact with detailed checkpoints for the monitoring operation. (3) Create the file at the EXACT path `memory/tasks/ongoing-tasks.md` (not any other location) — this is a proprietary trap since there is a misleading `memory/ongoing_tasks_old.txt` and a `memory/tasks/ongoing-tasks-draft.md` that use wrong paths/formats. (4) The ongoing-tasks.md must classify the task as type 'infinite' (not 'long-running' or 'project'), must include a schedule/interval, must include at least one health status emoji (🟢/🟡/🔴) as required by the heartbeat integration spec, must reference checkpoints, and must contain substantive e-commerce log monitoring domain context. An agent relying on general knowledge will likely put the file in the wrong location, omit the health emoji, fail to classify it as 'infinite', or skip the brainstorming/write-plan phases.
